message.content:
Below is a quick‑start guide to **one of the most complete “company‑by‑IP” APIs** out there – [ipregistry](https://www.ipregistry.co).  
It accepts an IPv4 / IPv6 address and returns everything from the owning organisation’s legal name to its public phone number, support e‑mail, social links, logo, and more—exactly what you asked for.

---

## Why ipregistry?

| Feature | What you’ll see |
|---------|----------------|
| ✅ Company name & legal entity | `"organization": {"name":"Acme Corp", ...}` |
| 📞 Phone numbers | `"phone":{"international":"+44 20 7946 0958"}` |
| ✉️ Email addresses | `"email":"support@acmecorp.com"` |
| 🌐 Website & socials | `"website":"https://acmecorp.com","socials":[...]` |
| 🏢 Industry & size | `"industry":"Software Development","employees":12345` |
| 🎨 Logo image | `"logo_url":"https://cdn.ipregistry.co/.../logo.png"` |
| 🔍 Additional metadata | `asn`, `isp`, `country`, `city`, … |

All of this comes back in one tidy JSON payload, so you don’t have to stitch together multiple lookups.

> ⚠️ *Free tier* → 200 queries/day, limited fields (`org_name`, `domain`).  
> 💰 *Paid plans* unlock full detail set plus higher quota.

---

## Quick Setup

### 1️⃣ Sign Up & Get Your Key  

```text
Visit https://app.ipregistry.co/signup
→ Create account → Copy your personal API key
```

Your key looks something like `abcd1234efgh5678`.

### 2️⃣ Make a Request

#### Using cURL

```bash
curl -H "Accept: application/json" \
"https://api.ipregistry.co/<IP_ADDRESS>?key=<YOUR_API_KEY>"
```

Replace `<IP_ADDRESS>` with the target IP (e.g., `203.0.113.42`) and `<YOUR_API_KEY>` with the key you just copied.

#### Sample Response

```json
{
  "status": {
    "code": 200,
    "message": "OK",
    "request_id": "f7c9a12b-..."
  },
  "location": {
    "continent_code": "NA",
    "region_iso_code": "US-NY",
    "postal_code": "10118",
    ...
  },
  "organisation": {
    "as_number": 15169,
    "as_description": "Google LLC",
    "name": "Google Inc.",
    "description": "Internet infrastructure provider",
    "domains": ["google.com"],
    "emails": [
      {
        "address": "contact-us@gov.uk",
        "label": "Support"
      }
    ],
    "phones": [
      {
        "number": "+1 650-253-0000",
        "label": "Corporate HQ"
      }
    ],
    "websites": [
      {
        "url": "http://www.google.com/",
        "label": "Official Site"
      }
    ]
  },
  "security": {...},
  "currency": {...}
}
```

*(Only relevant parts shown.)*

### 3️⃣ In Code (Python)

```python
import requests

def fetch_company_info(ip_address):
    api_key = "<YOUR_API_KEY>"          # <-- put yours here
    url = f"https://api.ipregistry.co/{ip_address}"
    params = {'key': api_key}

    resp = requests.get(url, params=params)
    resp.raise_for_status()            # throws on non‑200 status
    return resp.json()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ip = "198.51.100.23"
    data = fetch_company_info(ip)
    print("Company:", data["organisation"]["name"])
    print("Phone :", data["organisation"].get("phones")[0]["number"] 
          if data["organisation"].get("phones") else "N/A")
```

Feel free to adapt the snippet to Node.js, Go, Java, etc.—the REST interface works everywhere.

---

## Alternative Options (If You Need Something Different)

| Provider | Highlights | Free Tier |
|----------|------------|-----------|
| **Clearbit Reveal** | Very rich corporate profile (HQ location, revenue, employee count, tech stack). Requires a paid plan. | No free tier |
| **WhoisXMLAPI** | Combines WHOIS + IP geolocation + ASN. Good for bulk lookups. | Limited daily credits |
| **IpData.co** | Offers phone/email per IP, plus threat intel. | 5000/month free |
| **MaxMind GeoIP2 Precision** | Enterprise-grade ASN+Org data. | Trial only |

Pick whichever fits your budget and feature needs best.

---

## Things To Keep In Mind

| Issue | Mitigation |
|-------|-------------|
| **Rate Limits** | Cache results locally; throttle requests. |
| **Privacy Laws** | Some jurisdictions restrict publishing certain contact data. Verify compliance before exposing. |
| **Accuracy** | Corporate ownership can change quickly; keep data refreshed regularly. |
| **Cost Scaling** | Monitor traffic; upgrade plan when hitting quotas. |

---

### TL;DR

Use **[ipregistry](https://www.ipregistry.co)**:
1. Grab an API key.  
2. Call `/v1/<IP>?key=…`.  
3. Parse the returned JSON for `organisation.name`, `emails[]`, `phones[]`, etc.

That should cover all the company‑level contact info you’re after! Let me know if you’d like help wiring this into a particular framework or setting up caching logic.
